open_questions.question: When will the seven-municipality baseline corpus be committed under pipeline/baseline/?
Which first runtime should we prototype: Crawl4AI or a thinner HTTP + Playwright stack?
Can direct HTTP access reach the municipal domains from the intended runtime, or do we need browser fallback for network reasons as well as rendering?
What confidence/escalation threshold should move a task from small Apertus to the large planner?
How do we version and validate reusable site adapters generated by the planner?

next_actions: Merge/review PR #3 so the semantic-compiler/runtime design becomes the shared baseline.
Commit the baseline corpus for Binn, Biel/Bienne and Zürich first.
Build HTTP-first fetcher with cache, hashes and explicit browser escalation.
Add a first small-model classifier and compare it against the baseline.
